status_note: Status: review-02 response, 20 October 2026. The source-to-schedule mapping and bounded single-commit state correction pass independent checks. Physical annual, peak, setback-partition and summer-temperature values from v1/v2 (state defect) and v3 (missing-cloud sky-forcing defect) are withheld. A documented longwave method, consumed-field QC, new versioned annual runs and independent review are required. No empirical validation or population inference is claimed. Source aliases are resolved in 02_evidence/source_ledger.md and local_source_ledger.md; newly introduced review-02 diagnostic/code aliases require registry extension.

RQ-001.exact_claim: For one illustrative dwelling and selected Veneto survey response, the predeclared Padova-coordinate TMY comparison concerns annual useful sensible heating and maximum hourly load under three placements of the same 4/4/1 encoded 22°C high-setpoint hours. A 19°C setback permits heating outside those periods; valid physical effects await weather-forcing correction and new annual runs.
RQ-001.assumptions_and_uncertainty: The fixed-case schedule question and profile invariants survive the weather defect; v1/v2 state-defective and v3 forcing-defective loads do not answer its physical endpoints.
RQ-001.dependencies_next_action_owner: Methods owner: document, guard and independently test longwave input; run new Padova gate and matched alternatives. Author: admit effects only after new hourly checks and fresh independent review.
RQ-001.permitted_manuscript_wording: We test three placements of the same encoded high-setpoint hours in a fixed illustrative case; physical effect estimates are withheld pending corrected weather forcing.

RQ-002.exact_claim: The predeclared extension compares matched schedule placements under consistently retrieved Padova, Bolzano, Roma and Palermo coordinate TMYs, holding dwelling, response, setpoints and climate-E operating season fixed; all four-site physical load effects await valid longwave preprocessing and new annual runs.
RQ-002.dependencies_next_action_owner: Methods owner: complete weather QC and corrected reruns for all four sites after Padova gate; author/reviewer: verify paired inputs, hourly arithmetic and physical forcing before any comparison.
RQ-002.permitted_manuscript_wording: Four coordinate TMYs define controlled weather exposures for a pending matched comparison.

DAT-002.assumptions_and_uncertainty: Retrieval metadata and byte identity remain supported, but all 8,760 opaque-cover values are missing sentinel 99 in each EPW; provenance does not establish compatibility with the unguarded model sky routine. TMY is not a historical meter-matched year.
DAT-002.counterevidence_alternative_explanation: The weather reader consumes missing cloud cover as a physical value; the resulting v3 load simulations are not scientifically admissible. The acquired EPW's horizontal IR field offers a possible documented alternative after checks.
DAT-002.dependencies_next_action_owner: Methods owner: retain acquired hashes; document an IR-based or otherwise justified longwave treatment with consumed-field QC and an independent forcing audit.
DAT-002.permitted_manuscript_wording: Padova's TMY matches the documented PVGIS acquisition; its opaque sky-cover field is missing and requires explicit handling before load simulation.

new_claims.label: Executable command provenance
new_claims.exact_claim: The archived v3 manifests omit the required SITE argument in their recorded run command. The corrected historical invocation is the recorded Python executable, `-B`, the frozen v3 script path, and one explicit site argument; this is a provenance correction, not a claim that the historical manifest was executable as written. Future campaigns require a tested isolated replay entry point and exact executable, working directory and arguments.
